issues.issue: Deterministic completion was previously at risk of being framed as final certification.
issues.resolution: Dashboard/selfcheck now split matrix_status, deterministic_gate_status, ratification_status, final_integration_status; ratification_gate.py controls certification transition.

issues.issue: Ratification evidence binding gap can make models see unsupported high severity claims.
issues.resolution: Ratification state now carries top-level claims and evidence where every severity>=3 claim has explicit supports evidence IDs.

issues.issue: Default gate could accidentally read unrelated tick discussion_result.json.
issues.resolution: ratification_gate.py now filters latest discussion artifacts to Agent-COS-scoped content and otherwise fails closed.

issues.issue: Previous online discussion runs timed out or SIGTERMed without certification artifact.
issues.resolution: Current status remains LOCAL_COMPLETE_UNRATIFIED; timeout/no-artifact is an explicit not-certified state, not a success. Follow-up T1 run with gpt-5.5, MiMo, and DeepSeek produced certified discussion_result with no remaining risks; T3 degraded outcome remains a provider-availability caveat, not an Agent COS content gap.
